settings.heading: Center for Balanced Living
settings.description: Therapy, psychological evaluation, groups, and consultation for individuals and families. Trauma-informed care for adults, adolescents, and children.

pathway_clients.heading: CFBL Clinical Services
pathway_clients.description: Therapy, psychological evaluation, groups, and consultation for individuals and families. Trauma-based treatment for mental health across the lifespan.

settings.heading: CFBL Institute
settings.description: Continuing education in trauma-informed practice, assessment, and applied clinical reasoning. Live workshops and on-demand courses for licensed clinicians.

pathway_professionals.heading: CFBL Institute
pathway_professionals.description: Continuing education for professionals seeking integrated training in trauma. Live workshops and on-demand courses built for licensed clinicians.

settings.heading: MUSA
settings.description: Books, essays, and longer-form writing on psychology, memory, and being human. A publication by Dr. Angela Serravalle.

pathway_readers.heading: CFBL Publications
pathway_readers.description: Books, essays, and longer-form writing on psychology, memory, and being human. Writing by Dr. Angela Serravalle for readers everywhere.

settings.heading: Trauma-Informed Therapy
settings.description: Individual therapy for adults and adolescents navigating trauma, anxiety, grief, and identity. Evidence-based approaches tailored to your history and goals.

settings.heading: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Diagnostic clarity that informs treatment planning, school supports, and clinical decision-making.

settings.heading: Group Therapy
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, parenting, and somatic resourcing. Structured and time-limited, with open enrollment periods.

settings.heading: Consultation
settings.description: Case consultation for clinicians and referral conversations for families. Available by arrangement to licensed professionals and referring providers.

settings.heading: One practice. Three doors.
settings.subheading: Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA are three distinct properties under one roof — each serving a different audience with its own voice and editorial identity.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: A trauma-informed psychologist, educator, and writer. Founder of the Center for Balanced Living, the CFBL Institute, and MUSA.

settings.title: Trauma-Informed Assessment: Integrating the ACEs Framework
settings.description: Integrating psychometric reasoning with somatic and nervous-system awareness. A six-hour workshop for LCSWs, LPCs, psychologists, and PMHNPs.

settings.heading: New writing on psychology, memory, and being human.

settings.title: On Memory and the Body: What Trauma Teaches Us About Time
settings.lede: The body keeps a record that the mind is still learning to read. What clinical work reveals about the strangeness of traumatic memory.
